title: Can You Drink Alcohol on a Boat Trip in Madeira?
description: Yes. Local wine, poncha and beer come included on Chifbay trips, plus soft drinks. Swim before you drink, sip water in the sun, and the skipper stays sober.
heroAlt: Guests in silhouette raising glasses on a boat at golden hour off Câmara de Lobos
keywords: can you drink alcohol on a boat trip in Madeira
alcohol on a boat trip Madeira
wine on a sunset boat trip Madeira

images.prompt: Golden hour off Câmara de Lobos, Madeira, photographed from low on the water about 25 metres from a white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy, drifting slowly. On the stern deck, three guests in silhouette, seen from the side and from behind, raise wine glasses towards each other against a low orange sun. Apart from them, at the helm under the canopy, the skipper stands in silhouette with a plain water bottle in hand. Behind the boat, the warm lit houses of Câmara de Lobos climb the slope above the bay. Calm sea with golden reflections, true colours, no faces visible, no text.
images.alt: Guests in silhouette raising glasses on a boat at golden hour off Câmara de Lobos

images.prompt: After the swim at Fajã dos Padres, Madeira: a guest seen from behind wrapped in a striped towel sits on the stern swim platform of a white motor boat, feet in the water, a bottle of water beside her, the terraced green plots and brown cliff of Fajã dos Padres behind, late morning sun.
images.alt: A guest resting on the swim platform with a bottle of water after a swim

images.prompt: Dusk on the seafront avenue of Funchal, Madeira: a yellow taxi with a blue stripe waiting at a rank under palm trees, the city lights coming on up the hillside, the harbour wall and sea behind, no readable number plates or signs.
